The next bounded source increment is ready: Prismheart v11-ultra-controller-r2. Human NEXT resumed work at21:54:33 UTC; first source saved21:57:50; package recorded22:00:47. START was delivered as32418. This carries forward the complete r1 Folly/workshop source and preserves its archive.

Implemented consumer fixes: Settings, teaching and inactive/hidden windows pause simulation without replacing game mode; queued battle actions, movement and fades are retained. Controller/Settings polling continues. Boundaries clear held sources, buffered presses, timestamps, repeats and touch highlights, using existing releaseAll plus clearEdges for neutral rearming. Physical keyboard aliases aggregate into the same SRC.kb. Active teaching cancels on disconnect/close/focus loss; ordinary disconnect retains keyboard and other pads. App-local Control Help explains fallback navigation after seven-step teaching. Both independent source reviewers found no remaining concrete blocker or reset recursion.

Only tools/rpg_demo/index.html and the builder version marker differ from r1; bot.py and ten test scripts remain byte-identical. Frozen controller v1, shared Settings, bundle, native mappings and global Hero are unchanged. No contract behavior replacement. Reference inventory contains21 files, not21 comprehensively reviewed implementations.

Read docs/production/CONTROLLER-CONSUMER-ULTRA-R2.md and data/assets/controller-consumer-ultra-r2.json. Exact code/archive/hash pins and r1-to-r2 diff are retained. Source archive artifacts/source-snapshots/controller-consumer-ultra-r2-source.tar is270848bytes SHA8f3fab7be640e7470bf0cb5933d7abb165147d31b7097667195a5e41ddcbde45. index.html121012bytes SHA0c4ed03f9c66b38df28eaae45205e82de8b11bac002a2168ada01e526c91220f; build_demo.py14146bytes SHA8dba79c338d5f3f886eb3acb41dacf639da589af708c0f99fb1b247ebb9e7008. Manifest10497bytes SHAa70566fe04e87428513eb57352cf8295ecf9b89c19ec076c00e5be2992aad94b.

SOURCE IMPLEMENTED/REVIEWED ONLY. No syntax checks, tests, builds, imports, browser/play, Blender/render/native operations, publication, heavy grant/lease/PID or Git commit. No historical green transferred. Shared analog/disposal/extra taught-button limitations remain documented in frozen v1; consumer mitigation is not a module fix. Future build uses the retained r1 RPG dependency snapshot, not the controller reference. Runtime device/pause/recovery acceptance and the r1 four-route literal assertion adaptation remain deferred. Published v10, D2-build, current native intake, Reedwheel and all pending art scope are preserved.
